verdict.rationale: Undermind is a SaaS research service, so shipping official client SDKs is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack documents an official MCP server, an enterprise-only "programmatic queries via API," and a custom API built for one customer (GSK), but it never mentions an official SDK or client library. Probes also found no public OpenAPI spec. MCP and a bare enterprise API are adjacent capabilities that earn no credit toward an SDK story.
